annotations.title: Create a local pack rank config

description: Creates a local pack rank check config: where businessName sits in Google's local pack for one keyword at one location. The location is composed into the query as "<keyword> in <locationLabel>" — not geocoded. Run checks with run_local_pack_rank_check and read them with get_local_pack_rank. FREE: database only.

businessName.description: The business name as it appears on Google.

locationLabel.description: Place appended to the query, e.g. 'Shoreditch, London'.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: create_local_pack_rank_config
